title: Show HN: Codecademy.com, the easiest way to learn to code
author: zds
excerpt: I've been a longtime member @ HN, but I haven't been a developer. In fact, my only HN submission has been one asking how to learn to code (http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=820741). My cofounder and I decided to solve the problem by making a simple, interactive way to get started with Codecademy. We'd love your feedback. If you're interested in helping us to get more courses up (on any topic!), please send us an email at HN@codecademy.com.
guide_zh: Codecademy 展示以互动方式帮助新手学习编程的平台。
